attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is not `aetherius-of-cherson`, the bishop of Cherson kept on 7 March: this Aetherius is a martyr of Diocletian's persecution, and the page gives him no see, no city and no year. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
